pageTitle: Ajja's Earth Warriors — Back to Roots

program.title: Ajja's Earth Warriors
program.description: Become a guardian of the earth! Join Ajja's Earth Warriors to learn about composting along with lots of other outdoor fun of his times. Discover the magic of turning waste into wealth while enjoying traditional games that have entertained generations.

items.title: Composting Magic Circle
items.description: Learn the ancient art of composting from Ajja! Discover how kitchen scraps transform into black gold that nourishes Mother Earth.

items.title: Hands-On Compost Making
items.description: Get your hands dirty as you layer greens and browns, create your own mini compost bin, and understand the science behind decomposition.

items.title: Traditional Games Galore
items.description: Experience the joy of Lagori, Gilli Danda, and Kancha while learning about sustainable living through play and movement.

items.title: Earth Warrior Pledge
items.description: Take a special oath to protect our planet, create your Earth Warrior badge, and plan your home composting journey with take-home seeds.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Old clothes, water bottle, hat, small container for take-home compost

items.label: Take home
items.value: Mini compost bin, seeds, Earth Warrior badge
